method: Round-5 additions: 8-12 pharmaceutical PATENTS chosen to widen DRAWING STYLES/languages (CJK JP+KR+CN, French and German EPO B1, condensed/stereo-as-letters scans, two-component salts drawn as such). Same scoreable schema as pdf_manifest_round34.json. Every resolved molecule required TWO independent views to agree: a PubChem lookup by a name/CAS printed in the document, OR - where only a Roman-numeral label is printed - a PubChem same-connectivity structure search on the drawn reading; AND a reading of the drawing. Every SMILES round-trips through RDKit (parse + InChIKey verified equal to the recorded inchikey). confidence: name_match | drawing_read | unresolved | generic. pixel_verified is false everywhere (real documents).
excluded: Structures DRAWN but carrying no resolvable SMILES live in each group's `unscoreable` array (never in `molecules`, which score_run.py calls Chem.MolFromSmiles on). `unscoreable` holds Markush/R-group generics (generic:true) and any structure with no second independent view (confidence:unresolved). Repeat drawings of one compound are collapsed to ONE row (matched by name), with every page listed.

counts._note: structures_drawn, generic and unresolved are DEPICTION counts (same unit). molecules_scoreable counts rows in `molecules` (distinct compounds). The 24 generic depictions are described by 10 `unscoreable` rows and the 2 unresolved depictions by 2 rows, because near-duplicate generics are grouped.

RU2405786C2_asenapine.drawing_style: Russian-language granted patent (Rospatent). Vector CYRILLIC body text - a script the corpus has never had - with 'Схема 1' on p3 inserted as wide raster strips. Two full structures drawn side by side: the free base and the salt, the latter with maleic acid drawn IN FULL (cis-butenedioic acid) beside the base and the composition printed as a formula line 'C17H16ClNO . C4H4O4'.
RU2405786C2_asenapine.note: Cyrillic two-component-salt document. Схема 1 (p3) has two compound boxes: (1) азенапин and (2) малеат азенапина; box 2 contains TWO drawn species (the base plus a fully drawn cis maleic acid), so 3 depictions resolve to 2 distinct compounds. Each box prints its molecular formula and molecular weight, which is what pins the identification. Non-structure figures: X-ray powder diffractograms (рентгеновские дифрактограммы) on pp13-14 = built-in negatives.

molecules.name: asenapine
molecules.label: 1 азенапин (C17H16ClNO, Мм = 285,77)
molecules.basis: PubChem CID 163091 (Asenapine, C17H16ClNO) from the printed Cyrillic name 'азенапин' and the systematic name at p3 'транс-5-хлор-2-метил-2,3,3а,12b-тетрагидро-1H-дибенз[2,3:6,7]оксепино[4,5-c]пиррол'. Two views: the printed formula C17H16ClNO and Мм 285,77 match CID 163091 exactly, and the drawing shows the dibenz[b,f]oxepine bridged by O with the chlorine on the ring bonded to one ring-fusion carbon, fused to an N-methylpyrrolidine, with trans ring-fusion H's - the substitution pattern of CID 163091.
molecules.note: STEREO CAVEAT: the document names the compound only as 'транс-' (no R/S). Asenapine is the TRANS RACEMATE; PubChem CID 163091 carries a defined single-enantiomer stereo layer. Treat an opposite-enantiomer or stereo-free prediction as a stereo-level match, not a miss.

molecules.name: asenapine maleate
molecules.label: 2 малеат азенапина (C17H16ClNO . C4H4O4, Мм = 401,84)
molecules.basis: PubChem CID 6917875 (Asenapine Maleate, C21H20ClNO5) from the printed name 'малеат азенапина'. Two views: the printed composition line 'C17H16ClNO . C4H4O4' and Мм = 401,84 equal CID 6917875 (285.77 + 116.07 = 401.84), and the drawing shows the asenapine base with a separate, fully drawn CIS butenedioic acid (both COOH on the same side).
molecules.note: TWO-COMPONENT SALT drawn as two complete structures. A pipeline that segments the components emits asenapine (CID 163091) and maleic acid separately rather than this salt row.

US4194047_thienamycin.drawing_style: 1980 USPTO scan (ImageMagick full-page CCITT raster). Hand-inked carbapenem line art with condensed side-chain labels (SCH2CH2N=C(R)NH2, COOH, COO-) - plus an ABBREVIATION DEVICE the corpus has never had: a bracket box labelled 'Th' standing for the entire bicyclic thienamycin nucleus, with only the OH, N and CO2H drawn outside it.
US4194047_thienamycin.note: 3-page extract (original pp2, 19, 20) of the 38-page grant. p1 = the background page: thienamycin (I) drawn in full, the N-methylene genus formula (II) drawn three times (neutral, inner salt, resonance form) with X/Y variable, and the first 'Th' box. p2 = Examples 5-8: N-formimidoyl thienamycin (imipenem) in full, O-2,4,5-trichlorophenylisourea hydrochloride with a DRAWN .HCl, 2,4,5-trichlorophenol, plus two 'Th' shorthand depictions of N-guanyl thienamycin. p3 = Examples 9-12: two more 'Th' shorthand depictions, and N-trifluoroacetimidoyl and N-acetimidoyl thienamycin drawn in full. Depiction accounting: 16 total = 7 full-structure depictions (thienamycin, imipenem, the isourea.HCl twice, 2,4,5-trichlorophenol, N-trifluoroacetimidoyl, N-acetimidoyl) covering 6 distinct compounds, of which 5 resolve and 1 (the trifluoroacetimidoyl) does not; plus 9 generic depictions (formula (II) three times and six 'Th' shorthand boxes).

molecules.name: thienamycin
molecules.label: formula (I), printed 'Thienamycin is known to have the following structure'
molecules.basis: PubChem CID 441128 ((+)-Thienamycin, C11H16N2O4S) from the printed name. The drawing agrees: the 1-azabicyclo[3.2.0]hept-2-ene-2-carboxylic acid with a 1-hydroxyethyl at C6 and an SCH2CH2NH2 at C3.
molecules.note: the parent; every other full structure in this document is a derivative of its terminal amine.

molecules.name: imipenem
molecules.label: Example 5, 'Preparation of N-Formimidoyl Thienamycin'
molecules.basis: PubChem CID 104838 (Imipenem, C12H17N3O4S) from the printed name 'N-Formimidoyl Thienamycin'. The drawing agrees: thienamycin with the terminal amine converted to -N=CH-NH2.
molecules.note: imipenem is drawn in FULL here, unlike the N-guanyl analogues on the same page which use the 'Th' shorthand.

molecules.name: O-(2,4,5-trichlorophenyl)isourea hydrochloride
molecules.label: Example 7 reagent / Example 8 product, printed '0-2,4,5-TRICHLOROPHENYLISOUREA.HYDROCHLORIDE'
molecules.basis: PubChem CID 20535606 ((2,4,5-Trichlorophenyl) carbamimidate;hydrochloride, C7H6Cl4N2O). Reading the drawing (a 2,4,5-trichlorophenyl ring O-linked to C(=NH)NH2, with a separate '. HCl') canonicalises to InChIKey ZIXMIKUWDNFZJO-UHFFFAOYSA-N = CID 20535606 exactly.
molecules.note: a second DRAWN two-component salt in this document: the '. HCl' is written beside the structure.

molecules.name: 2,4,5-trichlorophenol
molecules.label: Example 8 starting material
molecules.basis: PubChem CID 7271 (2,4,5-Trichlorophenol, C6H3Cl3O) from the printed name; the drawing shows the trichlorinated phenol with its OH.
molecules.note: reacted with cyanamide (H2NCN, written as text on the arrow, not drawn as a structure).

molecules.name: N-acetimidoyl thienamycin
molecules.label: Example 12, 'Preparation of N-Acetimidoyl Thienamycin'
molecules.basis: PubChem CID 90669620 (C13H19N3O4S) from the printed name. Reading the drawing (thienamycin with -N=C(CH3)NH2) canonicalises to InChIKey QVJKBIZBZWXTJW-GTNGPMTGSA-N = CID 90669620 exactly.
molecules.note: the acetimidoyl homologue of imipenem; differs from it by one methyl.

unscoreable.name: N-trifluoroacetimidoyl thienamycin
unscoreable.label: Example 11
unscoreable.note: DRAWN IN FULL and NAMED ('Preparation of N-Trifluoroacetimidoyl Thienamycin'), but it has NO PubChem record. Reading the drawing (thienamycin with -N=C(CF3)NH2) gives molecular formula C13H16F3N3O4S and InChIKey MBTJHNMRBDDJOK-ATRFCDNQSA-N; a same-connectivity PubChem search returns nothing, so no reference CID exists and no SMILES is asserted here. Recorded so the depiction is not mistaken for an omission.

unscoreable.name: N-methylene thienamycin genus, formula (II) [X, Y variable]
unscoreable.label: formula (II), drawn 3x
unscoreable.note: The claimed genus: thienamycin whose terminal nitrogen carries =C(X)Y, with X and Y independently hydrogen, R, OR, SR or NR1R2 over a very wide substituent list. Drawn three times on one page - as the neutral form, as the zwitterionic inner salt (N+ / COO-), and as a resonance form. No single SMILES.

unscoreable.name: 'Th' nucleus shorthand depictions
unscoreable.label: Th-boxed structures, Examples 6, 7, 9, 10
unscoreable.note: NOT FULL STRUCTURES. A bracket labelled 'Th' stands for the whole bicyclic thienamycin nucleus while only the OH, the N-substituent and the CO2H are drawn. Four such depictions (N-guanyl thienamycin twice, N,N-dimethylaminomethylene once, the pivaloyloxymethyl ester once). A tool that silently expands 'Th' would produce a chemically correct molecule that was never drawn; these must not become ground truth.
